title: HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation
title_zh: HARP：面向基于大语言模型推荐的无训练双画像智能体通信

paragraphs.en: In LLM-based recommendation, memory effectively plays the role of a user-level agent, typically built on top of a memory-augmented backbone. Yet under this paradigm users and items remain asymmetric participants: only the user is given a structured profile; that profile is consumed inside a bandwidth-limited reranker prompt; and it is frozen after warmup. Starting from this observation, we recast LLM-based recommendation as an agentic-communication process in four stages: Build a self-description, Transmit it along the collaborative graph, Understand the other side, and Sync it from the next interaction. Analysing the dominant memory-augmented paradigm through this formulation, we identify three open communication challenges that current pipelines leave unaddressed: the item side never produces a comparable self-description (one-sided Build ); profile-level signals are routed only into a bandwidth-limited reranker prompt rather than into the retrieval stage where they would not compete for context tokens (prompt-trapped Understand ); and the user’s description is frozen after warmup with no principled update rule (absent Sync ). We instantiate the missing stages as Harp ( H omophily-aware A gentic R ecommendation via dual P rofiles ), a training-free, three-operator addition to a frozen LLM backbone: a rule-extracted symmetric item profile (zero extra LLM calls), a channel-decomposable profile-level homophily ℋ ⁡ ( ϕ u , ϕ i ) \mathcal{H}(\phi_{u},\phi_{i}) consumed at retrieval time rather than inside the reranker prompt, and a single-pass reflective update realising in-context profile evolution without any gradient step. On four public benchmarks (Yelp, Books, MovieTV, Goodreads), Harp lifts Hit@1 over the strongest published baseline by 6.9 % 6.9\% – 24.0 % 24.0\% , with family-wise Holm-corrected p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} on every dataset. Ablations and a per-case attribution study show that the operators contribute complementary gains, with the retrieval-side gate as the main source; we also report the trade-off introduced by the reflective pass. Our contribution is a unified formulation of agentic communication for LLM-based recommendation, together with a training-free three-operator instantiation on top of it.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于大语言模型的推荐中，记忆实际上扮演着用户级智能体的角色，通常构建在记忆增强的骨干模型之上。 然而在这个范式下，用户与物品仍然是不对称的参与方：只有用户拥有结构化的画像；该画像仅在带宽受限的重排器提示中被消费；并且在预热之后便被冻结。 从这一观察出发，我们将基于大语言模型的推荐重新构建为一个四阶段的智能体通信过程：构建自我描述、沿协同图传输、理解对方、以及从下一次交互中进行同步。 通过这一框架分析主流的记忆增强范式，我们识别出现有流水线尚未解决的三个开放性通信挑战：物品侧从不生成可比较的自我描述（缺失构建）；画像级信号仅被路由到带宽受限的重排器提示中，而不是被送入检索阶段（在该阶段它们无需争夺上下文词元）（提示困局的理解）；以及用户的描述在预热后被冻结且缺乏有原则的更新规则（同步缺失）。 我们将缺失的阶段实现为 Harp（基于双画像的同质性感知智能体推荐），这是一个免训练的、在冻结的大语言模型骨干之上增加的三个算子：规则提取的对称物品画像（零额外大语言模型调用）、可在通道上分解的画像级同质性 ℋ ⁡ ( ϕ u , ϕ i ) \mathcal{H}(\phi_{u},\phi_{i})（在检索时消费而非置于重排器提示内），以及单次遍历的反思式更新，无需任何梯度步骤即可实现上下文内的画像演化。 在四个公开基准（Yelp、Books、MovieTV、Goodreads）上，Harp 将 Hit@1 相比最强的已发表基线提升了 6.9 % 6.9\% – 24.0 % 24.0\%，且在所有数据集上均通过族级 Holm 校正达到 p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} 的显著性。 消融实验与逐案例归因研究表明，各算子贡献了互补的增益，其中检索侧的门控是主要来源；我们还报告了反思式更新所带来的权衡。 我们的贡献是为基于大语言模型的推荐提供了一个统一的智能体通信表述，并在此之上给出了一个免训练的三算子实现。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming the central reasoning engine of next-generation recommender systems Wu et al. (2024) ; Geng et al. (2022) ; Liu et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2025a) . In the most representative agentic recommendation paradigm Zhang et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) ; Tang et al. (2026) , a user is modelled as an LLM agent with persistent memory, and personalised recommendations are produced by routing collaborative-neighbour memories into a reranker prompt. Yet this paradigm provides only a partial answer: the user side is equipped with memory while the item side has no structured profile aligned with the user’s; the user profile is consumed solely inside a bandwidth-limited reranker prompt; and the profile built at warmup is not revised from recommendation outcomes afterwards. We recast LLM-based recommendation as a four-stage agentic-communication process between user and item agents ( Build – Transmit – Understand – Sync ), and show that the dominant paradigm implements only a partial version of it, leaving three communication challenges open (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正在成为下一代推荐系统的核心推理引擎 Wu et al. (2024) ; Geng et al. (2022) ; Liu et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2025a) 。 在最具代表性的智能体化推荐范式 Zhang et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) ; Tang et al. (2026) 中，用户被建模为一个具有持久记忆的 LLM 智能体，个性化推荐通过将协同邻居记忆路由到重排序提示中来产生。 然而这一范式只提供了部分答案：用户侧配备了记忆，而物品侧没有与用户侧对齐的结构化画像；用户画像仅在一个带宽受限的重排序提示中被消费；并且在预热阶段构建的画像之后不会根据推荐结果进行修订。 我们将基于 LLM 的推荐重新构建为用户智能体与物品智能体之间的四阶段智能体通信过程（构建–传输–理解–同步），并表明主流范式仅实现了它的一个部分版本，留下了三个尚未解决的通信挑战（图 1 ）。

sents.en: We recast LLM-based recommendation as a four-stage agentic-communication process between user and item agents ( Build – Transmit – Understand – Sync ), and show that the dominant paradigm implements only a partial version of it, leaving three communication challenges open (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: 我们将基于 LLM 的推荐重新构建为用户智能体与物品智能体之间的四阶段智能体通信过程（构建–传输–理解–同步），并表明主流范式仅实现了它的一个部分版本，留下了三个尚未解决的通信挑战（图 1 ）。

paragraphs.en: The stages Build – Transmit – Understand – Sync borrow directly from heterogeneous message passing on graphs Hu et al. (2020) ; Schlichtkrull et al. (2018) and from the classical study of homophily on social networks McPherson et al. (2001) . The decomposition plays a dual role: as an analytical tool that asks which of the four stages a given pipeline implements and how well, and as a generative scaffold that prescribes the operator to add once a missing stage is identified. The four-stage view is thus an analytical framework for diagnosing a pipeline, not a model in itself. Recommender systems have passed through three architectural generations (collaborative filtering Koren et al. (2009) ; Sarwar et al. (2001) , graph neural networks He et al. (2020) ; Veličković et al. (2017) , and the recent agentic paradigm Wu et al. (2024) ), yet the collaborative signal pervading all three is indexed by interaction overlap rather than description-level compatibility, hence size-blind: whenever two agents’ description sets differ sharply in breadth, raw interaction-overlap similarity inflates the match for reasons of degree rather than relevance, and the pre-rerank candidate list inherits that inflation. An agentic communication pipeline therefore needs a profile-level, asymmetric coverage measure read from the query side’s vantage, which is the role the channel-decomposable homophily ℋ \mathcal{H} of § 3.2 plays once the item side is also allowed to speak.
paragraphs.zh: 构建—传递—理解—同步这四个阶段直接借鉴了图上的异质消息传递 Hu et al. (2020)；Schlichtkrull et al. (2018)，以及社交网络上同质性的经典研究 McPherson et al. (2001)。 这一分解具有双重作用：作为分析工具，它考察给定流水线实现了四个阶段中的哪几个以及实现得如何；作为生成性框架，它规定了一旦识别出缺失的阶段应添加哪种算子。 因此，四阶段视角是用于诊断流水线的分析框架，而不是模型本身。 推荐系统已经历了三代架构（协同过滤 Koren et al. (2009)；Sarwar et al. (2001)，图神经网络 He et al. (2020)；Veličković et al. (2017)，以及近来的智能体范式 Wu et al. (2024)），然而贯穿三代的协同信号都以交互重叠而非描述层面的兼容性来索引，因而具有规模盲性：当两个智能体的描述集合在广度上差异悬殊时，原始的交互重叠相似度会因度数而非相关性而夸大匹配程度，预重排候选列表便继承了这种夸大。 因此，智能体通信流水线需要一个从查询方视角读取的、档案级的非对称覆盖度量，而这正是 §3.2 中可按信道分解的同质性 ℋ \mathcal{H} 在允许物品方也发声时所扮演的角色。

paragraphs.en: Applied to the memory-augmented family on four public benchmarks (Yelp, Amazon Books, MovieTV, Goodreads), this analysis identifies three open challenges where the communication falls silent. (Challenge 1) Asymmetric Build . The user side carries a multi-field profile while the item side has no profile in the same schema. (Challenge 2) Bandwidth-trapped Understand . Concatenating the user profile into the reranker does not move ranking accuracy: by the time the reranker is called, its context is fixed and the context budget is dominated by the memory block; Understand is the stage where profile-level signal must enter before the reranker is called. (Challenge 3) Absent Sync . Profiles built at warmup are not calibrated against the feedback that warmup itself produces.
paragraphs.zh: 将该分析应用于四个公开基准（Yelp、Amazon Books、MovieTV、Goodreads）上的记忆增强系列方法后，识别出通信沉默之处的三个开放挑战。 （挑战 1）非对称构建。 用户侧携带多字段画像，而物品侧没有同构模式的画像。 （挑战 2）带宽受限的理解。 将用户画像拼接进重排器并不能提升排序准确率：在调用重排器时，其上下文已经固定，且上下文预算被记忆块占据；理解是画像级信号必须在调用重排器之前进入的阶段。 （挑战 3）缺失的同步。 预热阶段构建的画像并未针对预热本身产生的反馈进行校准。

paragraphs.en: Each challenge is addressed by a primitive already validated elsewhere, composed without retraining. Against Challenge 1 , a structured-JSON user profile, in the spirit of agent-maintained profiles in prior agentic recommenders Zhang et al. (2024) , is used on the user side, and a schema-aligned item profile is introduced via rule extraction at no extra LLM cost. Against Challenge 2 , the collaborative retrieval score is re-weighted by a profile homophily that generalises the scalar edge-homophily ratio Zhu et al. (2020) to a sum over semantic channels; homophily is used here as an analytical quantity, not as an optimisation target. Against Challenge 3 , a single Chain-of-Thought reflective pass Wei et al. (2022) ; Shinn et al. (2023) ; Madaan et al. (2023) optionally guarded by a conservative critic is added, realising in-context evolution of the user profile without any gradient update, a self-evolving -agent primitive in the sense of the recent survey Gao et al. (2025) . The composition is Harp ( H omophily-aware A gentic R ecommendation via dual P rofiles ), a training-free addition to a frozen LLM backbone that operates entirely through the LLM-as-agent interaction loop; its novelty lies in the systematic identification of these three primitives as the complementary response to the three challenges within the memory-augmented agentic family, each separable in ablation (§ 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Formulation. An agentic-communication formulation that models LLM-based recommendation as a four-stage process Build – Transmit – Understand – Sync and, used analytically, surfaces the three communication gaps that the dominant memory-augmented agentic paradigm leaves open.
paragraphs.zh: 形式化建模。 一种智能体通信形式化建模方法，将基于大语言模型的推荐建模为四个阶段的过程——构建–传递–理解–同步，并在分析性使用时，揭示主流的记忆增强智能体范式所遗留的三个通信缺口。

paragraphs.en: Method. Harp , a three-operator training-free addition to a frozen LLM backbone: a rule-extracted symmetric item profile, a channel-decomposable homophily-gated retrieval, and a single-pass reflective update, each aligned with one of the three gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 Harp，作为对冻结大语言模型主干的免训练三算子扩展：规则提取的对称物品画像、通道可分解的同质性门控检索，以及单次遍历的反思式更新，每者分别对应三个差距之一。

paragraphs.en: Empirical evaluation. On four public benchmarks, Harp achieves state-of-the-art on every metric, lifting Hit@1 by 6.9 % 6.9\% – 24.0 % 24.0\% over the strongest published baseline; ablations and per-case traces further confirm the effectiveness and complementarity of each operator.
paragraphs.zh: 实证评估。 在四个公开基准上，Harp 在每项指标上都达到了最先进水平，相较于最强的已发表基线将 Hit@1 提升了 6.9%–24.0%；消融实验与逐案例轨迹进一步证实了每个算子的有效性与互补性。

paragraphs.en: The agentic paradigm represents users as LLM-managed stateful memories Zhang et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Tang et al. (2026) ; Huang et al. (2025) , yielding a chronology from stateless vanilla LLM Liu et al. (2023) , static per-user memory Huang et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025) , dynamic self-reflective memory Zhang et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Tang et al. (2026) , to a dynamic memory graph managed by a lightweight LM Chen et al. (2026) . Within this line, RecMind Wang et al. (2024) augments user agents with tool-calling for external knowledge, and RecAgent Wang et al. (2025) simulates realistic user behaviour with LLM-driven decision loops. Related work also improves modality representations for recommendation Tang et al. (2025) , uses LLMs to understand user text in conversational recommenders Yuan et al. (2026) , and generates semantic item identifiers for cross-domain recommendation Hu et al. (2026) . A parallel infrastructure thread provides pluggable agentic memory backends: A-MEM Xu et al. (2026) proposes structured agentic memory for LLM agents, H-Mem Ye et al. (2026) introduces hybrid multi-dimensional memory for long-context conversations, and a recent task-aware retrieval thread Tao et al. (2026) makes the retrieval step itself context-adaptive. Harp differs by lifting both sides to profile level and consuming the resulting homophily at retrieval time rather than inside a reranker prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体范式将用户表示为由 LLM 管理的有状态记忆 Zhang et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Tang et al. (2026) ; Huang et al. (2025)，由此形成一条演进脉络：从无状态的原始 LLM Liu et al. (2023)，到静态的每用户记忆 Huang et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025)，再到动态的自反记忆 Zhang et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Tang et al. (2026)，直至由轻量级 LM 管理的动态记忆图 Chen et al. (2026)。 在这一脉络中，RecMind Wang et al. (2024) 通过调用外部知识工具来增强用户智能体，而 RecAgent Wang et al. (2025) 则利用 LLM 驱动的决策循环来模拟真实的用户行为。 相关工作还改进了用于推荐的模态表示 Tang et al. (2025)，利用 LLM 在对话式推荐系统中理解用户文本 Yuan et al. (2026)，并为跨域推荐生成语义化物品标识符 Hu et al. paragraphs.en: Recent work shows LLM agents can self-improve via in-context rewrites Gao et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Shinn et al. (2023) ; Madaan et al. (2023) or make retrieval decisions adaptively Singh et al. (2025) ; Asai et al. (2024) ; Jiang et al. (2023) . Voyager Wang et al. (2023) accumulates reusable skills in Minecraft, ChatDev Qian et al. (2024) organises software tasks as multi-agent role-play dialogues, and Self-RAG Asai et al. (2024) trains the model to decide when and what to retrieve. In the agentic-context-engineering view Zhang et al. (2026) , the agent’s prompt itself becomes an evolvable artefact, a perspective Harp instantiates for recommendation profiles. Harp differs by applying an acceptance check (Eq. 10 ) to profile evolution and routing the homophily signal to the retrieval stage rather than the generation stage.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究表明，LLM 智能体可以通过上下文重写实现自我改进（Gao et al. (2025)；Zhang et al. (2026)；Wang et al. (2023)；Shinn et al. (2023)；Madaan et al. (2023)），或者自适应地做出检索决策（Singh et al. (2025)；Asai et al. (2024)；Jiang et al. (2023)）。Voyager（Wang et al. (2023)）在 Minecraft 中积累可复用的技能，ChatDev（Qian et al. (2024)）将软件任务组织为多智能体角色扮演对话，而 Self-RAG（Asai et al. (2024)）则训练模型决定何时检索以及检索什么内容。 在智能体式上下文工程的视角下（Zhang et al. (2026)），智能体的提示词本身成为一个可演化的构件，Harp 正是为推荐画像实例化了这一视角。 Harp 的不同之处在于，它对画像演化应用了接受性检查（式 10），并将同质性信号路由到检索阶段而非生成阶段。

paragraphs.en: where M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} is a memory block aggregated along the selected neighbours N ⁡ ( u ) N(u) and ϕ u \phi_{u} is an optional user profile. On top of this shared backbone, Harp introduces a layer of channel-level understanding above memory: both user and item carry a structured profile whose four channel fields ϕ v = ( ϕ v ( c ) ) c ∈ 𝒞 \phi_{v}=(\phi_{v}^{(c)})_{c\in\mathcal{C}} are aligned over the channel set 𝒞 = { preference , quality , context , audience } \mathcal{C}=\{\mathrm{preference},\mathrm{quality},\mathrm{context},\mathrm{audience}\} , whose per-channel fields are phrase sets disjoint by construction (R1–R4 in § 3.2 ; Table 1 ). This aligned schema lets user–item matching decompose into separately measurable semantic channels, and turns profile-level homophily (Eq. 6 ) into an explicit quantity used for retrieval-side gating and post-warmup reflective rewriting. The prevailing memory-augmented family corresponds to the special case in which three restrictions are simultaneously imposed ( absent item profile, profile injected only via prompt, profile never updated ); the three operators in § 3.2 –§ 3.4 lift these in turn. Three operational constraints run through the section: (C1) the reranker prompt has finite token budget B B , so any content in the ϕ u \phi_{u} slot trades against M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} ; (C2) the backbone LLM is frozen; (C3) each user receives at most one accepted reflective-update trajectory (applied at end of warmup; the trajectory may itself consist of T evo T_{\mathrm{evo}} reflection calls at different history offsets, with T evo = 1 T_{\mathrm{evo}}=1 in main experiments). A full notation table is in Appendix E.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 其中 M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} 是沿选定的邻居 N ⁡ ( u ) N(u) 聚合得到的记忆块，而 ϕ u \phi_{u} 是可选的用户画像。 在这一共享骨干之上，Harp 在记忆之上引入了一层通道级理解：用户和物品都携带一个结构化画像，其四个通道字段 ϕ v = ( ϕ v ( c ) ) c ∈ 𝒞 \phi_{v}=(\phi_{v}^{(c)})_{c\in\mathcal{C}} 在通道集 𝒞 = { preference , quality , context , audience } \mathcal{C}=\{\mathrm{preference},\mathrm{quality},\mathrm{context},\mathrm{audience}\} 上对齐，各通道字段在构造上互不相交的短语集合（见 § 3.2 的 R1–R4；表 1）。 这种对齐的模式让用户—物品匹配可以分解为可分别度量的语义通道，并将画像层面的同质性（式 6）转化为一个显式的量，用于检索侧的门控以及预热结束后的反思式重写。 主流的记忆增强方法族对应于同时施加三项限制的特例（没有物品画像、画像仅通过提示注入、画像从不更新）；§ 3.2–§ 3.4 中的三个算子依次解除这些限制。 本节贯穿三个操作性约束：(C1) 重排器的提示具有有限的 token 预算 B B ，因此 ϕ u \phi_{u} 槽位中的任何内容都会与 M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} 相互竞争；(C2) 骨干 LLM 被冻结；(C3) 每个用户至多接受一条被采纳的反思式更新轨迹（在预热结束时应用；该轨迹本身可以由在不同历史偏移处的 T evo T_{\mathrm{evo}} 次反思调用组成，主实验中 T evo = 1 T_{\mathrm{evo}}=1）。 完整的符号表见附录 E.1。

RuleExtract \mathrm{RuleExtract} is formalised as a deterministic, zero-LLM shallow semantic parser, fully parametrised by a dataset-level ontology map 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and domain phrase lexicon 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , executed in four rules R1–R4 (ontology projection, lexicon-guided encoding, quality-signal induction, channel-exclusivity projection) that route metadata and reviews into the four pairwise-disjoint channel fields; per-rule definitions, per-dataset lexicons, and coverage statistics are in Appendix E.10 .
paragraphs.zh: 面向同一信道对齐模式，这使得在 N I ∼ 10 4 N_{I}\sim 10^{4} – 10 5 10^{5} 规模下商品侧画像仍然可行。 RuleExtract \mathrm{RuleExtract} 被形式化为一个确定性的、无需大语言模型的浅层语义解析器，完全由数据集级本体映射 𝒮 \mathcal{S} 和领域短语词表 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 参数化，并通过四条规则 R1–R4（本体投影、词表引导编码、质量信号归纳、信道排他性投影）执行，将元数据和评论路由到四个两两不相交的信道字段中；各规则的定义、各数据集的词表以及覆盖率统计见附录 E.10。

paragraphs.en: A non-trivial design choice is whether profile signal should enter via retrieval-side candidate reshaping or reranker-side context injection . The two are not information-equivalent: the former changes which neighbours inform the reranker, the latter changes the evidence it relies on. We argue the former is strictly preferable here for two reasons. Budget (induced by C1): the reranker’s context token budget B B is hard; once B B is saturated, every token added to the ϕ u \phi_{u} slot displaces M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} , so prompt-side injection is effectively a zero-sum substitution between “profile evidence” and “collaborative memory”. Mechanism : under C2 (frozen LLM), the reranker cannot learn to balance the two sources, and its input is already fixed by the retrieved candidates; with misleading candidates, even the optimal profile context cannot reliably promote y u y_{u} . Placing the profile at the retrieval side lets it act on the recoverable stage . We record this intuition formally as Remark 2 in Appendix C.3 ; Table 3 in § 4 provides the empirical comparison (the two routes are labelled CH and RI in the ablation).
paragraphs.zh: 一个非平凡的设计选择是：画像信号应当通过检索侧的候选重排进入，还是通过重排侧的上下文注入进入。 这两种方式在信息上并不等价：前者改变的是哪些邻居为重排器提供信息，后者改变的是重排器所依赖的证据。 我们认为，在本文中前者严格更优，理由有二。 预算（由 C1 导致）：重排器的上下文 token 预算 B B 是硬性约束；一旦 B B 被占满，加入 ϕ u \phi_{u} 槽位的每一个 token 都会挤占 M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} ，因此提示侧注入实际上成为“画像证据”与“协同记忆”之间的零和替换。 机制：在 C2（冻结 LLM）之下，重排器无法学习如何平衡这两种信息源，且其输入已由检索到的候选固定；当候选具有误导性时，即使是最优的画像上下文也无法可靠地提升 y u y_{u} 。 将画像置于检索侧，可使其作用于可恢复的阶段。 我们将这一直觉正式记录为附录 C.3 中的注记 2；§ 4 中的表 3 提供了实证比较（两条路线在消融实验中分别标记为 CH 和 RI）。

paragraphs.en: The critic is a conservative safeguard: it keeps the old profile when the proposal is clearly less supported by the warmup cases, which prevents the reflective rewrite from pulling the user profile away from H u H_{u} . We use a zero-extra-LLM critic, a deterministic check of how well the proposed profile covers the warmup target items, so the gate’s marginal cost over Reflect \mathrm{Reflect} is negligible (Appendix E.6 ). Each user sees only one pass of Eq. 10 (C3): additional passes would multiply the LLM cost while reusing the same warmup record ℛ u \mathcal{R}_{u} .
paragraphs.zh: 评审器（critic）是一道保守的保障措施：当提案明显较少得到预热案例的支持时，它会保留旧的用户画像，从而防止反思性改写将用户画像从 H u H_{u} 拉偏。 我们使用零额外 LLM 的评审器（critic），即对提案画像覆盖预热目标项目的程度进行确定性检查，因此该门槛相对于 Reflect \mathrm{Reflect} 的边际成本可以忽略不计（附录 E.6）。 每个用户只进行一次公式 10（C3）的传递：额外的传递会在复用同一预热记录 ℛ u \mathcal{R}_{u} 的同时成倍增加 LLM 成本。

paragraphs.en: The three operators of § 3.2 –§ 3.4 are designed to be separable : each addresses one structural challenge that its ablation re-introduces. Vocabulary mismatch (addressed by § 3.2 ): when the item has no profile ( ϕ i ≡ ∅ \phi_{i}\equiv\varnothing ), there is no second vocabulary to align against; Channel capture (addressed by § 3.3 ): prompt-injected ϕ u \phi_{u} competes with M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} for the reranker budget B B (C1), so any profile-content gain is capped by the collaborative-memory space yielded; Communicative drift (addressed by § 3.4 ): profiles written at warmup are not calibrated against warmup feedback, and the update of Eq. 10 performs this calibration once. Full pseudocode, per-case traces, and complexity analysis are in Appendix E.2 , E.5 and E.7 ; each row of the main ablation (§ 4 , Table 3 ) is labelled by the challenge it isolates, so the whole table can be read as a test of the three operators’ separability.
paragraphs.zh: §3.2–§3.4 的三个算子被设计为可分离的：每个算子应对一个结构性挑战，而消融该算子会重新引入该挑战。 词汇不匹配（由 §3.2 解决）：当物品没有画像（ϕ i ≡ ∅ \phi_{i}\equiv\varnothing）时，就不存在可用于对齐的第二词汇；信道捕获（由 §3.3 解决）：被提示注入的 ϕ u \phi_{u} 会与 M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} 争夺重排器的预算 B B（C1），因此任何画像内容带来的收益都受限于协同记忆所让出的空间；交流漂移（由 §3.4 解决）：在预热阶段写入的画像并未针对预热反馈进行校准，而式 10 的更新恰好执行了一次这样的校准。 完整的伪代码、逐案例的追踪以及复杂度分析见附录 E.2、E.5 和 E.7；主消融实验（§4，表 3）的每一行都以其所隔离的挑战命名标注，因此整张表可以被看作是对三个算子可分离性的检验。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on four InstructRec Xu et al. (2025) benchmarks: Amazon Books (7.4K users, 120.9K items; abbreviated Books ), Goodreads (11.7K / 57.4K), MovieTV (5.6K / 29.0K), Yelp (3.0K / 31.6K), using the original splits and natural-language user instructions. Baselines span three families: traditional recommenders (LightGCN He et al. (2020) , SASRec Kang and McAuley (2018) , P5 Geng et al. (2022) ); single-sided LLM/agentic methods (Vanilla LLM Liu et al. (2023) , iAgent Xu et al. (2025) , AgentCF Zhang et al. (2024) , RecBot Tang et al. (2026) , i 2 Agent Xu et al. (2025) ); and memory-augmented agentic methods, whose strongest published representative on these splits is MemRec Chen et al. (2026) . All baseline numbers are imported from the originating papers ( † in Table 2 ); per-dataset characteristics and baseline details are in Appendix B.1 and B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四个 InstructRec Xu et al. (2025) 基准上进行评估：Amazon Books（7.4K 用户，120.9K 物品；简称 Books）、Goodreads（11.7K / 57.4K）、MovieTV（5.6K / 29.0K）、Yelp（3.0K / 31.6K），使用原始数据划分和自然语言用户指令。基线涵盖三大类：传统推荐器（LightGCN He et al. (2020)、SASRec Kang and McAuley (2018)、P5 Geng et al. (2022)）；单侧 LLM/智能体方法（Vanilla LLM Liu et al. (2023)、iAgent Xu et al. (2025)、AgentCF Zhang et al. (2024)、RecBot Tang et al. (2026)、i²Agent Xu et al. (2025)）；以及记忆增强的智能体方法，其在该数据划分上已发表的最强代表是 MemRec Chen et al. (2026)。所有基线数值均引自原始论文（表 2 中的 †）；各数据集特征与基线细节见附录 B.1 和 B.2。

paragraphs.en: Harp is instantiated on a frozen gpt-4o-mini backbone and runs a single round of profile warmup per user. The Understand operator uses homophily floors α u ​ i = 0.4 \alpha_{ui}{=}0.4 on user–item edges and α u ​ u = 0.3 \alpha_{uu}{=}0.3 on user–user edges, with a preference-dominant channel weighting ( w c ) (w_{c}) . The Sync operator runs T evo = 1 T_{\mathrm{evo}}{=}1 reflective pass per user (conditioned on the second-to-last interaction) optionally filtered by the critic. The retrieval budget k k is chosen on a development split from { 4 , 8 , 16 } \{4,8,16\} and fixed at k = 16 k{=}16 for all main-table numbers. Hit@1 improvements are tested by per-dataset one-sided binomial tests with Wilson 95% CIs (Appendix D.1 ); the cross-dataset joint null is controlled by Holm–Bonferroni at family-wise α = 0.05 \alpha{=}0.05 ; ladder transitions use exact paired McNemar. Our code is available at https://github.com/Jove-Zhen/HARP.
paragraphs.zh: Harp 实例化于冻结的 gpt-4o-mini 骨干模型之上，并对每个用户执行单轮的画像预热。 Understand 算子在用户–物品边上使用同质性下限 α_{ui}=0.4，在用户–用户边上使用 α_{uu}=0.3，并采用偏好主导的通道权重 (w_{c})。 Sync 算子对每个用户运行 T_{evo}=1 次反思式处理（以倒数第二次交互为条件），并可选地由评审器过滤。 检索预算 k 从 {4,8,16} 中在开发集上选取，并在所有主表数字中固定为 k=16。 Hit@1 的提升通过逐数据集的单侧二项检验进行检验，并给出 Wilson 95% 置信区间（附录 D.1）；跨数据集的联合零假设由 Holm–Bonferroni 方法在族错误率 α=0.05 下控制；阶梯转换使用精确配对 McNemar 检验。 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Jove-Zhen/HARP 获取。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports the complete results. Harp consistently outperforms all baselines on every dataset and every metric. Three patterns are worth noting. First , the dominance holds across all three baseline families: Hit@1 over the strongest traditional baseline is 1.8 × 1.8\times – 2.5 × 2.5\times , over the strongest single-sided agent i 2 Agent it is + 23 % +23\% / + 51 % +51\% / + 31 % +31\% / + 43 % +43\% on Books/Goodreads/MovieTV/Yelp, and over the strongest memory-augmented baseline MemRec it ranges from + 6.9 % +6.9\% (Books) to + 24.0 % +24.0\% (Yelp). Second , the gain is largest on Yelp and Goodreads ( + 24.0 % +24.0\% / + 17.2 % +17.2\% ), consistent with Harp ’s profile-based re-weighting of neighbours exactly where the collaborative-only signal is weakest. Third , the relative gain over MemRec shrinks monotonically with k k (e.g. Yelp + 24.0 % → + 14.3 % → + 9.4 % +24.0\%\to+14.3\%\to+9.4\% at Hit@ { 1 , 3 , 5 } \{1,3,5\} ), indicating that Harp promotes the ground truth into the top-1 slot rather than merely reshuffling an already-correct pool. On the full test splits, the Wilson 95% CI lower bound of Harp ’s Hit@1 strictly dominates the MemRec point estimate with margins + 2.38 / + 5.98 / + 4.38 / + 9.93 +2.38/+5.98/+4.38/+9.93 pp on Books/Goodreads/MovieTV/Yelp; per-dataset one-sided binomial p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} and Holm–Bonferroni adjusted p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} (Appendix D.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表2报告了完整结果。 Harp在所有数据集和所有指标上均一致地优于所有基线。 有三个模式值得注意。 第一，这种优势在全部三类基线家族中都成立：相对最强传统基线，Hit@1 为 1.8 × 1.8\times – 2.5 × 2.5\times ；相对最强单侧智能体 i 2 Agent，在 Books/Goodreads/MovieTV/Yelp 上为 + 23 % +23\% / + 51 % +51\% / + 31 % +31\% / + 43 % +43\% ；相对最强记忆增强基线 MemRec，则从 + 6.9 % +6.9\% （Books）到 + 24.0 % +24.0\% （Yelp）。 第二，增益在 Yelp 和 Goodreads 上最大（ + 24.0 % +24.0\% / + 17.2 % +17.2\% ），这与 Harp 基于画像对邻居进行重新加权的设计相一致——恰恰在协同信号最弱的地方发挥作用。 第三，相对 MemRec 的相对增益随 k k 单调递减（例如 Yelp 在 Hit@ { 1 , 3 , 5 } \{1,3,5\} 上为 + 24.0 % → + 14.3 % → + 9.4 % +24.0\%\to+14.3\%\to+9.4\% ），这表明 Harp 是将真实答案推进到 top-1 位置，而不仅仅是对已经正确的候选池进行重排。 在完整测试集划分上，Harp 的 Hit@1 的 Wilson 95% 置信区间下界严格优于 MemRec 的点估计，在 Books/Goodreads/MovieTV/Yelp 上的优势分别为 + 2.38 / + 5.98 / + 4.38 / + 9.93 +2.38/+5.98/+4.38/+9.93 个百分点；每个数据集的单侧二项检验 p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} ，经 Holm–Bonferroni 校正后 p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} （附录 D.1）。

paragraphs.en: To systematically attribute contributions, we define five ablation configurations sharing the same frozen backbone and differing only in “which Harp components are enabled”: Memory ( ϕ u = ϕ i = ∅ \phi_{u}{=}\phi_{i}{=}\varnothing ; no gating, no reflection); Monologue (user profile ϕ u \phi_{u} injected into the reranker prompt only); Dialogue (both ϕ u , ϕ i \phi_{u},\phi_{i} enabled, homophily gating ℋ \mathcal{H} used on retrieval; no prompt injection, no reflection); Consult (both profiles but retrieval-side gate disabled ; a direct “retrieval-side vs. prompt-side” contrast against Dialogue ); Harp (full pipeline: both profiles, retrieval-side gate, prompt injection, one-pass reflection). Table 3 reports the ablation on the 1,000 1{,}000 -user Yelp subsplit; Figure 3 replicates the same five rungs across all four benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统地归因各部分的贡献，我们定义了五种消融配置，它们共享同一个冻结的主干网络，仅在「启用了哪些 Harp 组件」上有所不同：Memory（ϕu=ϕi=∅，无门控、无反思）；Monologue（仅将用户画像 ϕu 注入重排序器提示词）；Dialogue（同时启用 ϕu 与 ϕi，检索时使用同质性门控 ℋ，无提示词注入、无反思）；Consult（同时使用两个画像但禁用检索侧门控，与 Dialogue 形成「检索侧 vs. 提示词侧」的直接对比）；Harp（完整流水线：两个画像、检索侧门控、提示词注入以及一遍式反思）。 表 3 报告了在 1,000 用户 Yelp 子划分上的消融结果；图 3 在全部四个基准上复现了同样的五档配置。

sents.zh: 表 3 报告了在 1,000 用户 Yelp 子划分上的消融结果；图 3 在全部四个基准上复现了同样的五档配置。

paragraphs.en: (1) The retrieval-side gate is the primary source of gain: Monologue → \to Dialogue jumps H@1 by + 5.7 +5.7 pp; prompt-side injection alone ( Consult vs. Memory ) does not move H@1. (2) The gain needs the profiles to enter the gate: Monologue (user profile only) and Consult (both profiles, no gate) stay at .578 .578 – .580 .580 , the same as Memory ; only Dialogue , which uses both profiles in the retrieval-side gate, improves. (3) Prompt injection and Sync add a small residual: Dialogue → \to Harp adds + 0.8 +0.8 pp H@1 for the two together (prompt injection alone does not move H@1). Paired McNemar (Appendix D.6 ) confirms Monologue → \to Dialogue ( p = × 10 − 6 p{=}7.2\!\times\!10^{-6} ) and Consult → \to Harp ( p = × 10 − 7 p{=}2.5\!\times\!10^{-7} ) are significant, Memory → \to Monologue lies within sampling noise ( p = 0.94 p{=}0.94 ), and Dialogue → \to Consult is significantly negative ( − 5.5 -5.5 pp, p = × 10 − 5 p{=}1.0\!\times\!10^{-5} ), which supports consuming the profile on the retrieval side.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 检索侧门控是收益的主要来源：Monologue → \to Dialogue 使 H@1 提升了 + 5.7 +5.7 个百分点；仅靠提示词侧注入（ Consult 对比 Memory ）不会改变 H@1。(2) 该收益需要用户画像进入门控：Monologue（仅用户画像）和 Consult（两个画像，无门控）停留在 .578 .578 – .580 .580 ，与 Memory 相同；只有 Dialogue 在检索侧门控中使用两个画像，才有所提升。(3) 提示词注入与 Sync 带来少量残余收益：Dialogue → \to Harp 使两者合计提升 + 0.8 +0.8 个百分点 H@1（仅提示词注入不会改变 H@1）。配对 McNemar 检验（附录 D.6 ）证实 Monologue → \to Dialogue（ p = × 10 − 6 p{=}7.2\!\times\!10^{-6} ）和 Consult → \to Harp（ p = × 10 − 7 p{=}2.5\!\times\!10^{-7} ）显著，Memory → \to Monologue 处于抽样噪声范围内（ p = 0.94 p{=}0.94 ），而 Dialogue → \to Consult 显著为负（ − 5.5 -5.5 个百分点， p = × 10 − 5 p{=}1.0\!\times\!10^{-5} ），这支持在检索侧消费用户画像。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows the five-rung ladder on all four benchmarks (matched 1,000 1{,}000 -user subsplits) for three representative metrics: Hit@1, Hit@3, and NDCG@3. The conclusion is robust: Monologue ≈ \approx Memory , Consult ≈ \approx Memory , Dialogue > > Monologue is the largest single-rung jump on Yelp, MovieTV and Books, and the Dialogue → \to Harp residual (injection and Sync together) is positive on Yelp/MovieTV/Goodreads ( + 0.8 / + 0.5 / + 1.3 +0.8/+0.5/+1.3 pp Hit@1) and slightly negative on Books ( − 0.4 -0.4 pp). Net Hit@1 gains over Memory : + 6.3 / + 3.4 / + 1.9 / + 1.9 +6.3/+3.4/+1.9/+1.9 pp (Yelp/MovieTV/Books/Goodreads); a per-user repair-source decomposition (Appendix D.3 ) confirms that the majority of L0-miss → \to L4-hit transitions are already present at the Dialogue stage, attributing the primary engine of improvement to the retrieval-side gate. The four-metric ladder line plots are in Appendix Figure 5 .

paragraphs.en: To further understand the mechanism behind the gains, we perform a per-user outcome-transition decomposition on three deep-analysis subsplits (Yelp/MovieTV/Books, each 1,000 1{,}000 users): each user is tagged by the triple ( L 0 , L 2 , L 4 ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } 3 (L_{0},L_{2},L_{4})\in\{0,1\}^{3} indicating hit/miss under Memory , Dialogue , and Harp . The net repair counts over Memory are + 63 / + 34 / + 19 +63/+34/+19 users ( + 6.3 / + 3.4 / + 1.9 +6.3/+3.4/+1.9 pp), with the ratio of retrieval-gate repairs (Dial-rep) to Dialogue → \to Harp repairs (Sync-rep, injection and Sync together) stable at 5.3 : 1 5.3{:}1 (Yelp), 3.2 : 1 3.2{:}1 (MovieTV), 3.0 : 1 3.0{:}1 (Books). This confirms that the Dialogue -stage homophily gate is the primary engine of improvement, with the Dialogue → \to Harp step (injection and Sync ) providing marginal gains on the sub-population that Dialogue alone cannot reach. Notably, this step also introduces a small number of regression events ( − 0.4 -0.4 pp on Books), reflecting a trade-off between conservatism and coverage; three qualitative case studies in Appendix E.5 examine it. Furthermore, the Pearson correlation between a profile-length proxy and per-user gain is ρ ∈ [ − 0.048 , − 0.005 ] \rho\in[-0.048,-0.005] , confirming that reflection reshapes the profile’s composition rather than its length.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步理解增益背后的机制，我们在三个深度分析子集（Yelp/MovieTV/Books，各 1{,}000 名用户）上进行逐用户结果转移分解：每个用户用三元组 ( L 0 , L 2 , L 4 ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } 3 (L_{0},L_{2},L_{4})\in\{0,1\}^{3} 标注，表示其在 Memory、Dialogue 和 Harp 下的命中/未命中情况。 相对于 Memory 的净修复人数为 + 63 / + 34 / + 19 +63/+34/+19 名用户（+ 6.3 / + 3.4 / + 1.9 +6.3/+3.4/+1.9 个百分点），其中检索门修复（Dial-rep）与 Dialogue → \to Harp 修复（Sync-rep，包括 injection 与 Sync）的比例稳定在 5.3 : 1 5.3{:}1（Yelp）、3.2 : 1 3.2{:}1（MovieTV）、3.0 : 1 3.0{:}1（Books）。 这证实了 Dialogue 阶段的同质性门控是提升的主要引擎，而 Dialogue → \to Harp 步骤（injection 与 Sync）则在 Dialogue 单独无法覆盖的子群体上提供边际增益。 值得注意的是，该步骤也会引入少量回退事件（Books 上为 − 0.4 -0.4 个百分点），反映出保守性与覆盖面之间的权衡；附录 E.5 中的三个定性案例研究对此进行了考察。 此外，画像长度代理指标与逐用户增益之间的 Pearson 相关系数为 ρ ∈ [ − 0.048 , − 0.005 ] \rho\in[-0.048,-0.005]，这证实了反思改变的是画像的构成而非其长度。

paragraphs.en: We recast LLM-based recommendation from an agentic-communication perspective in which user and item agents exchange structured self-descriptions along a four-stage process ( Build – Transmit – Understand – Sync ), use the formulation analytically on the dominant memory-augmented agentic paradigm to identify three open communication challenges (asymmetric Build , bandwidth-trapped Understand , and absent Sync ), and introduce Harp , a three-operator training-free instantiation on a frozen LLM backbone: a symmetric item profile ( Build ), a channel-decomposable homophily-gated retrieval ( Understand ), and a single-pass reflective update ( Sync ). On four public benchmarks, Harp lifts Hit@1 by + 6.9 +6.9 – 24.0 % 24.0\% over the strongest published baseline, and ablations further confirm that operator-level gains align with the three challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从智能体通信的视角重新审视基于大语言模型的推荐：用户智能体与物品智能体在一个四阶段流程（构建–传输–理解–同步）中交换结构化的自我描述；利用该表述对主流的记忆增强智能体范式进行分析，识别出三个尚未解决的通信挑战（非对称的构建、带宽受限的理解以及缺失的同步）；并提出 Harp，一个基于冻结大语言模型骨干的无训练三算子实现：对称的物品档案（构建）、可按通道分解且由同质性门控的检索（理解），以及单次反射式更新（同步）。 在四个公开基准上，Harp 相比最强的已发表基线将 Hit@1 提升了 +6.9–24.0%，消融实验进一步证实算子层面的收益与这三个挑战一一对应。

paragraphs.en: A rich literature studies how artificial agents develop communication protocols Foerster et al. [2016] , Lazaridou et al. [2016] , Mordatch and Abbeel [2018] , Ren et al. [2020] , and recent work extends this to LLM-based agents communicating in natural language Li et al. [2023] , Hong et al. [2024] , Du et al. [2023] , typically in multi-round dialogues. A parallel line shows that LLM agents can accumulate reusable skills through experience Wang et al. [2023] , Zhu et al. [2023] , Madaan et al. [2023] , Shinn et al. [2023] : Voyager builds a skill library in Minecraft, GITM decomposes tasks into learnable skills, and self-refine approaches demonstrate iterative LLM self-improvement. Harp uses both lenses orthogonally: user and item agents exchange one-shot structured messages measured by ranking accuracy rather than dialogue fluency, and the reflective update operates on the agent’s profile under a acceptance rule (Eq. 10 ) rather than accumulating a skill library. The reranker-prompt bandwidth constraint (C1 in § 3.1 ) and the channel decomposability of Remark 1 matter most in this one-shot, high-throughput setting.
paragraphs.zh: 大量文献研究了人工智能体如何发展出通信协议 Foerster et al. [2016]、Lazaridou et al. [2016]、Mordatch and Abbeel [2018]、Ren et al. [2020]，而近期工作将这一方向扩展到以自然语言交流的基于 LLM 的智能体 Li et al. [2023]、Hong et al. [2024]、Du et al. [2023]，通常以多轮对话的形式进行。 另一条并行的研究线表明，LLM 智能体可以通过经验积累可复用的技能 Wang et al. [2023]、Zhu et al. [2023]、Madaan et al. [2023]、Shinn et al. [2023]：Voyager 在 Minecraft 中构建技能库，GITM 将任务分解为可学习的技能，而自我改进方法展示了 LLM 的迭代式自我提升。 Harp 从两个视角正交地运用这两条线索：用户智能体和物品智能体交换一次性结构化消息，其效果以排序准确率而非对话流畅度来衡量；同时反思式更新是在某一接受规则（公式 10）下作用于智能体的档案（profile），而非积累技能库。 重排序器-提示的带宽约束（§ 3.1 中的 C1）以及注记 1 的信道可分解性，正是在这种一次性、高吞吐量的场景下最为关键。

paragraphs.en: A growing body treats recommendation as an LLM-agent task Zhang et al. [2024] , Huang et al. [2025] , Wang et al. [2024] , Friedman et al. [2023] , Xu et al. [2025] , Tang et al. [2026] : AgentCF Zhang et al. [2024] pioneers the user/item-as-agent formulation with free-text memories on both sides, but neither side carries a structured, channel-aligned profile; InteRecAgent Huang et al. [2025] introduces tool-augmented user agents; iAgent Xu et al. [2025] keeps a static per-user profile with no reflective update; i 2 Agent Xu et al. [2025] adds a per-user reflection loop but without an acceptance rule, so every proposed revision is applied; RecBot Tang et al. [2026] supports session-level dynamic memory; RecAgent Wang et al. [2025] simulates user behaviour. Relative to this line, three design choices in Harp are jointly novel: (i) a structured profile on the item side with the same four-channel schema as the user side (no prior work gives the item agent a structured, channel-aligned profile), (ii) a homophily signal consumed during retrieval rather than inside the reranker prompt, and (iii) an acceptance check on the reflective update (self-reflective predecessors apply every proposed revision). A parallel line develops general agentic memory architectures beyond recommendation (A-MEM Xu et al. [2026] , Memory-R1 Yan et al. [2026] , Zep Rasmussen et al. [2025] , H-Mem Ye et al. [2026] ) offering infrastructure pluggable at the Transmit stage; a recent dynamic-graph thread Tao et al. [2026] makes retrieval augmentation itself task-aware, conceptually close to our Understand routing.

sents.en: Relative to this line, three design choices in Harp are jointly novel: (i) a structured profile on the item side with the same four-channel schema as the user side (no prior work gives the item agent a structured, channel-aligned profile), (ii) a homophily signal consumed during retrieval rather than inside the reranker prompt, and (iii) an acceptance check on the reflective update (self-reflective predecessors apply every proposed revision).

paragraphs.en: A parallel line tunes or grounds the LLM against the recommendation objective rather than operating it as an agent: TALLRec Bao et al. [2023] , CoLLM Zhang et al. [2025b] , LLaRA Liao et al. [2024] , BIGRec Bao et al. [2025] , A-LLMRec Kim et al. [2024] , LLMRec Wei et al. [2024] , and ONCE Liu et al. [2024] ; surveys Wu et al. [2024] place these on a spectrum of what in the LLM is adapted. Harp is complementary and sits at the interaction-loop end: it keeps the LLM frozen, leaves the collaborative signal in place, and restructures how user and item agents exchange profiles along the pipeline; it can in principle be layered on top of any of these backbones. The retrieval-vs-prompt rationale of § 3.3 is motivated by adaptive retrieval in retrieval-augmented generation Asai et al. [2024] , Jiang et al. [2023] , where evidence is selected before generation; its support in our setting is the ablation of § 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 一条并行的路线是针对推荐目标对大语言模型（LLM）进行微调或接地，而不是将其作为智能体来运行：TALLRec Bao et al. [2023]、CoLLM Zhang et al. [2025b]、LLaRA Liao et al. [2024]、BIGRec Bao et al. [2025]、A-LLMRec Kim et al. [2024]、LLMRec Wei et al. [2024]，以及 ONCE Liu et al. [2024]；综述 Wu et al. [2024] 将这些方法按照 LLM 中被适配的部分置于一个光谱上。 Harp 是互补性的，位于交互循环一端：它保持 LLM 冻结，保留协同信号，并重构用户智能体与物品智能体在流水线中交换画像的方式；原则上它可以叠加在上述任何骨干方法之上。 § 3.3 中关于检索与提示的取舍理由，受到检索增强生成中自适应检索的启发 Asai et al. [2024]、Jiang et al. [2023]，其中证据在生成之前被选取；它在我们设定中的支持来自 § 4 的消融实验。

paragraphs.en: Three concurrent LLM-agent currents intersect with Harp without overlapping its main contribution: the self-evolving-agent line Gao et al. [2025] , Zhang et al. [2026] (replacing fine-tuning with in-context rewrites; our Sync is one such primitive but we do not claim a new mechanism), the agentic-context-engineering view Zhang et al. [2026] (our dual-profile schema, Table 1 , is a user/item-symmetric realisation specific to recommendation), and agentic RAG Singh et al. [2025] (our homophily-gated score, Eq. 7 , is a retrieval decision gated by a profile-level homophily rather than a learned policy). Channel-wise decomposition of graph homophily itself is not new: multi-relational GNNs Schlichtkrull et al. [2018] , Hu et al. [2020] and per-class edge-homophily Zhu et al. [2020] already exploit the idea at the interaction / class-label level. Relative to those threads, Harp lifts the decomposition to the profile level (agent-authored, agent-mutable), and the three-challenge analysis of the four-stage Build–Transmit–Understand–Sync formulation is the contribution specific to agentic recommendation.
paragraphs.zh: 三条并行的 LLM 智能体研究脉络与 Harp 相交但不重叠其主要贡献：自我进化智能体方向 Gao et al. [2025]、Zhang et al. [2026]（用上下文内改写取代微调；我们的 Sync 属于此类原语，但我们并不声称提出了新机制）、智能体化上下文工程视角 Zhang et al. [2026]（我们的双画像模式，见表 1，是面向推荐的用户/物品对称实现）、以及智能体 RAG Singh et al. [2025]（我们的同质性门控分数，即式 7，是由画像级同质性门控的检索决策，而非学习得到的策略）。 对图同质性本身进行按通道分解并不新颖：多关系 GNN Schlichtkrull et al. [2018]、Hu et al. [2020] 以及按类别的边同质性 Zhu et al. [2020] 已在交互/类别标签层面利用了这一思想。 相对于这些工作，Harp 将该分解提升到画像层面（由智能体撰写、可由智能体修改），而针对四阶段 Build–Transmit–Understand–Sync 提法的三挑战分析才是专门面向智能体化推荐的贡献。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on four public datasets widely used in recommendation research, used under their original terms of use for research, encompassing diverse domains such as e-commerce, social reading, entertainment, and local services. As stated in § 4 , we adopt the versions of these datasets augmented with natural-language user instructions from InstructRec Xu et al. [2025] . The original data sources and their characteristics are summarised below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在推荐系统研究中广泛使用的四个公开数据集上进行评估，这些数据集按其原始使用条款用于研究目的，涵盖电子商务、社交阅读、娱乐和本地服务等多样领域。 如 § 4 所述，我们采用 InstructRec Xu et al. [2025] 用自然语言用户指令增强过的这些数据集的版本。 原始数据来源及其特征总结如下。

paragraphs.en: Derived from the Amazon review dataset Ni et al. [2019] , this subset focuses on book recommendations. It is characterised by extremely sparse interactions and a very large item space; user preferences in this domain are typically stable and highly content-driven, centred on specific genres, authors, or themes.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集源自 Ni 等人[2019] 的亚马逊评论数据集，此子集专注于图书推荐。 其特点是交互极为稀疏且物品空间非常庞大。 该领域中的用户偏好通常稳定且高度受内容驱动，围绕特定的体裁、作者或主题展开。

It features strong community interactions and rich metadata about books, including series information, and users often exhibit series-aware reading behaviours and are influenced by social signals.

paragraphs.en: Also originating from the Amazon review dataset Ni et al. [2019] , this dataset covers movies and TV shows. The domain is marked by volatile user preferences often influenced by immediate context or trending content; while metadata such as genre and cast are important, item recency frequently plays a critical role in user decision-making.

paragraphs.en: Sourced from the Yelp Dataset , this dataset consists of reviews for local businesses such as restaurants and services. It is characterised by strong categorical constraints (e.g., cuisine type) and by the critical importance of attributes like price range and location; user preferences are often highly context-dependent.

paragraphs.en: These models mostly represent the pre-LLM paradigm (P5 being the exception), in which historical information is encoded as dense latent vectors without explicit semantic memory.

paragraphs.en: LightGCN He et al. [2020] : a graph-collaborative-filtering model that simplifies the GCN design by removing feature transformation and nonlinear activation, learning user/item embeddings via linear propagation on the user–item interaction graph.

sents.en: [2020] : a graph-collaborative-filtering model that simplifies the GCN design by removing feature transformation and nonlinear activation, learning user/item embeddings via linear propagation on the user–item interaction graph.
sents.zh: [2020]：一种图协同过滤模型，它通过移除特征变换和非线性激活来简化 GCN 的设计，在用户—物品交互图上通过线性传播学习用户/物品嵌入。

paragraphs.en: SASRec Kang and McAuley [2018] : a self-attentive sequential recommender that models the entire user sequence to capture long-term and dynamic dependencies over the history.
paragraphs.zh: SASRec Kang and McAuley [2018]：一种自注意力序列推荐器，对用户的完整序列进行建模，以捕捉历史中的长期和动态依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: P5 Geng et al. [2022] : a unified framework that formulates recommendation tasks as sequence-to-sequence language modelling over a pre-trained T5 backbone, representing users and items as sequence tokens within personalised prompts.
paragraphs.zh: P5（Geng 等） [2022]：一个统一框架，将推荐任务表述为基于预训练 T5 骨干网络的序列到序列语言建模，并在个性化提示中将用户和物品表示为序列词元。

sents.en: P5 Geng et al.
sents.zh: P5（Geng 等）

sents.en: [2022] : a unified framework that formulates recommendation tasks as sequence-to-sequence language modelling over a pre-trained T5 backbone, representing users and items as sequence tokens within personalised prompts.
sents.zh: [2022]：一个统一框架，将推荐任务表述为基于预训练 T5 骨干网络的序列到序列语言建模，并在个性化提示中将用户和物品表示为序列词元。

paragraphs.en: These approaches operate on raw interaction histories or static profiles without maintaining a persistent, structured, and evolving semantic memory.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法直接作用于原始交互历史或静态画像，而无法维护一个持久的、结构化的、持续演化的语义记忆。

paragraphs.en: Vanilla LLM Liu et al. [2023] : direct zero-shot prompting of an instruction-tuned LLM ( gpt-4o-mini in our protocol), in which the user’s history is serialised into a natural-language context and the LLM selects from the candidate list; a baseline measuring the LLM’s inherent capability without any memory design.
paragraphs.zh: 原生 LLM Liu 等 [2023]：对经过指令微调的 LLM（在我们的协议中为 gpt-4o-mini）进行直接的零样本提示，其中用户的历史被序列化为自然语言上下文，由 LLM 从候选列表中进行选择；这是一个衡量 LLM 在没有任何记忆设计情况下的固有能力基线。

sents.en: Vanilla LLM Liu et al.
sents.zh: 原生 LLM Liu 等

paragraphs.en: iAgent Xu et al. [2025] : an LLM agent with a static per-user profile constructed from historical interactions and descriptive data; the profile is fed into the LLM as context but does not adapt over time after the initial construction.
paragraphs.zh: iAgent（Xu 等人） [2025]：一种大语言模型智能体，其基于历史交互和描述性数据构建静态的单用户画像；该画像作为上下文输入大语言模型，但在初始构建之后不会随时间自适应更新。

paragraphs.en: AgentCF Zhang et al. [2024] : an agent-based collaborative-filtering framework in which user- and item-agents interact autonomously and update their own preferences/characteristics, with memory updates localised to the interacting agents.

paragraphs.en: RecBot Tang et al. [2026] : a conversational recommender in which an LLM maintains a dynamic dialogue history and updates user-preference estimates during multi-turn sessions; dynamics are bounded to the current session.
paragraphs.zh: RecBot（Tang 等人） [2026]：一个对话式推荐系统，其中大语言模型维护动态对话历史，并在多轮会话过程中更新用户偏好估计；动态性仅限于当前会话。

paragraphs.en: Under a fixed reranker context budget B B and a frozen LLM backbone (constraints (C1)–(C2) of § 3.1 ), injecting the user profile ϕ u \phi_{u} on the retrieval side (Eq. 7 ) is preferable to injecting it on the reranker-prompt side (Eq. 2 ), for two reasons:

paragraphs.en: Budget competition. Once the budget is saturated, every prompt-side profile token trades against a token of the collaborative-memory block M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} , which is the most information-dense block in the prompt; prompt-side injection is therefore a zero-sum trade rather than a free addition.
paragraphs.zh: 预算竞争。 一旦预算达到饱和，提示侧配置文件中的每一个 token 都要与协作记忆块 M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}}（提示中信息密度最高的块）进行权衡；因此，提示侧注入是一种零和交换，而非免费的附加内容。

paragraphs.en: We treat this as a design rationale rather than a theorem: its direction-of-change is consistent with our data (Table 3 : retrieval-side + 5.5 +5.5 pp vs. prompt-side ≤ 0.2 \leq 0.2 pp on 1,000 1{,}000 -user Yelp), but its magnitude is a property of the specific dataset/backbone and is not claimed to extrapolate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将其视为一种设计依据（design rationale）而非定理：其变化方向与我们的数据一致（表 3：在 1,000 1{,}000 用户 Yelp 上，检索侧提升 + 5.5 +5.5 个百分点，而提示侧 ≤ 0.2 \leq 0.2 个百分点），但其幅度是特定数据集/骨干网络的属性，我们并不声称其可外推。

paragraphs.en: Lemma 1 establishes that ℋ \mathcal{H} itself is additively decomposable over the four channels; however, the move from “decomposition at the ℋ \mathcal{H} level” to “attribution at the Hit@1 level” is empirical rather than guaranteed by the lemma. As an observational split of the + 5.7 +5.7 pp Monologue → \to Dialogue Hit@1 lift on Yelp under the default preference-dominant weights, we measure per-channel Hit@1 deltas of + 3.2 +3.2 pp ( preference ), + 0.7 +0.7 pp ( quality ), + 1.1 +1.1 pp ( context ), + 0.6 +0.6 pp ( audience ), summing to + 5.6 +5.6 pp. We report these as per-channel measurements rather than a strict causal decomposition, which would require four independent leave-one-out ablations that we did not run. The preference -dominated pattern ( + 3.2 +3.2 pp, over half of the total) is corroborated by a channel-dissection analysis of 6,348 6{,}348 extracted preference phrases on Yelp: clusters dominated by concrete cuisine/category nouns achieve per-user Hit@1 = 0.666 =0.666 , while clusters dominated by vague sentiment/location words reach only 0.615 0.615 . paragraphs.en: Remark 1 separates the Monologue channel (the user profile injected via the reranker prompt as a one-way broadcast) from the Dialogue channel (the same profile injected via the homophily gate into retrieval scoring) by definition . Definition-level distinguishability, however, does not entail empirical distinguishability: if the two channels produced near-identical ranking distributions under the shared LLM backbone and reranker, the agentic-communication framing of Harp would risk reducing to a naming convention. On the 1,000 1{,}000 -user Yelp deep-analysis subsplit we therefore test the null of distributional equivalence H 0 : 𝒟 ⁡ ( rank ∣ Monologue ) = 𝒟 ⁡ ( rank ∣ Dialogue ) H_{0}:\;\mathcal{D}(\text{rank}\mid\text{Monologue})=\mathcal{D}(\text{rank}\mid\text{Dialogue}) , and provide three complementary pieces of evidence against H 0 H_{0} .
paragraphs.zh: 注1在定义上将独白通道（经由重排序提示注入的用户画像，作为单向广播）与对话通道（同一画像经由同质性门控注入检索打分）区分开来。 然而，定义层面的可区分性并不意味着经验层面的可区分性：如果这两个通道在共享的LLM骨干和重排序器下产生了几乎相同的排序分布，那么Harp的智能体通信框架就有可能沦为一种命名约定。 因此，在1,000 1{,}000用户的Yelp深度分析子集划分上，我们检验分布等价的零假设 H 0 : 𝒟 ⁡ ( rank ∣ Monologue ) = 𝒟 ⁡ ( rank ∣ Dialogue ) H_{0}:\;\mathcal{D}(\text{rank}\mid\text{Monologue})=\mathcal{D}(\text{rank}\mid\text{Dialogue}) ，并提供三方面互补的证据来反驳 H 0 H_{0} 。

paragraphs.en: For the same 1,000 1{,}000 users, let r i Mem , r i Mono , r i Dial ∈ { 1 , … , | C | , ∞ } r_{i}^{\text{Mem}},\,r_{i}^{\text{Mono}},\,r_{i}^{\text{Dial}}\in\{1,\dots,|C|,\infty\} denote the ranks of the ground-truth item under Memory, Monologue and Dialogue respectively ( r = 1 r=1 means Hit@1; right-censored ∞ \infty if the item is absent from the retrieval pool). The three runs share the same user ordering and the same retrieval pool, so all comparisons below are paired . Each test falsifies H 0 H_{0} from a different angle ( marginal ranking , per-user outcome , joint-distribution separability ), and each alone suffices to reject H 0 H_{0} ; jointly, they rule out any empirical identification of Monologue with Dialogue.

paragraphs.en: Stratified paired rank test (marginal-ranking angle). Stratify the 1,000 1{,}000 users into four quantile-based strata on r i Mem r_{i}^{\text{Mem}} ; within each stratum with n ≥ 20 n\geq 20 compute a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank Z Z -score on ( r i Mono , r i Dial ) (r_{i}^{\text{Mono}},r_{i}^{\text{Dial}}) , and combine the stratum-wise Z Z ’s via Stouffer’s method with weights ∝ n stratum \propto\sqrt{n_{\text{stratum}}} . This controls for baseline difficulty and tests whether Dialogue systematically out-ranks Monologue at equal difficulty .
paragraphs.zh: 分层配对秩检验（边际排序角度）。 将 1,000 名用户按 r i Mem r_{i}^{\text{Mem}} 划分为四个基于分位数的层；在每个样本量 n ≥ 20 n\geq 20 的层内，对 ( r i Mono , r i Dial ) (r_{i}^{\text{Mono}},r_{i}^{\text{Dial}}) 计算配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩 Z Z 分数，并通过 Stouffer 方法以权重 ∝ n stratum \propto\sqrt{n_{\text{stratum}}} 合并各层的 Z Z 值。 该方法控制了基线难度，检验在相同难度下「Dialogue」是否系统性地排名高于「Monologue」。

paragraphs.en: Improvement-set asymmetry (per-user-outcome angle). Relative to Memory, label each user with two { 0 , 1 } \{0,1\} flags: A = A= “Monologue improves Hit@1 over Memory” and B = B= “Dialogue improves Hit@1 over Memory”. Apply an exact two-sided binomial test to the discordant counts | A ∖ B | |A\setminus B| vs. | B ∖ A | |B\setminus A| . Under H 0 H_{0} the two counts should be approximately equal; a significant asymmetry implies the two channels help different users .

Significance is assessed against a 1,000 1{,}000 -permutation label-shuffle null using the add-one estimator p = ( 1 + | { null ≥ obs } | ) / ( 1 + B ) p=(1+|\{\text{null}\geq\text{obs}\}|)/(1+B) . Under H 0 H_{0} any classifier’s balanced accuracy concentrates near 0.5 0.5 ; above-chance accuracy directly falsifies distributional equivalence.

paragraphs.en: E1 ( p = 6.1 × 10 − 11 p=6.1\times 10^{-11} ) rejects, at matched baseline difficulty, the equality of marginal rank distributions. E2 ( p = 6.7 × 10 − 12 p=6.7\times 10^{-12} ) shows that the set of users improved by Dialogue (over Memory) and the set improved by Monologue (over Memory) are highly non-overlapping ( | B ∖ A | = 108 |B\setminus A|=108 vs. | A ∖ B | = 29 |A\setminus B|=29 ), so the two channels help substantively different subsets of users. E3 ( p = 3 × 10 − 3 p=3\times 10^{-3} , bal-acc 0.532 0.532 ) shows that even from a single rank value and its Memory-difficulty context, a classifier recovers the source channel at an accuracy that is small but permutation-significantly above chance (null std 0.013 0.013 ); the small effect size is expected since the two channels share the same LLM backbone and reranker and differ only in per-user ranking structure, but the permutation significance is already sufficient to reject distributional equivalence. The three angles yield complementary, concordant evidence jointly rejecting H 0 H_{0} .

sents.en: E3 ( p = 3 × 10 − 3 p=3\times 10^{-3} , bal-acc 0.532 0.532 ) shows that even from a single rank value and its Memory-difficulty context, a classifier recovers the source channel at an accuracy that is small but permutation-significantly above chance (null std 0.013 0.013 ); the small effect size is expected since the two channels share the same LLM backbone and reranker and differ only in per-user ranking structure, but the permutation significance is already sufficient to reject distributional equivalence.
sents.zh: E3（p=3×10⁻³，bal-acc 0.532）表明，即使仅从一个秩值及其 Memory 难度上下文出发，分类器也能以虽然小但在置换检验下显著高于随机水平（零假设标准差 0.013）的准确率恢复出源通道；效应量较小是符合预期的，因为两种通道共享相同的 LLM 主干和重排序器，仅在逐用户的排序结构上有所不同，但置换显著性已足以拒绝分布等价的假设。

sents.en: The three angles yield complementary, concordant evidence jointly rejecting H 0 H_{0} .
sents.zh: 这三个角度给出了互补且一致的证据，共同拒绝 H₀。

paragraphs.en: Dialogue is not a re-wording of Monologue: the channel leaves a per-user identifiable signature in the ranking trajectory. This empirical identifiability is a necessary prerequisite for the four-stage Build–Transmit–Understand–Sync agentic-communication framing of § 3 , and distinguishes Harp from a prompt-engineering baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 对话并非独白的换个说法：该通道会在排序轨迹中留下可识别到具体用户的签名。 这种经验层面的可识别性是第 3 节「构建–传递–理解–同步」四阶段智能体通信框架的必要前提，也将 Harp 与提示工程基线区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The main table reports aggregate Hit@1 gaps such as Monologue → \to Dialogue + 5.7 +5.7 pp. Such gaps could in principle be driven by sampling noise, particularly when the two configurations are evaluated on highly correlated per-user outcomes. To upgrade the claim “each ablation step is non-accidental” to a statistical conclusion, we report exact paired McNemar tests of per-user Hit@1 between adjacent configurations on the 1,000 1{,}000 -user Yelp deep-analysis subsplit (Table 5 ).

The McNemar null is H 0 : b = c H_{0}:\;b=c , i.e. “the Hit@1 differences between A A and B B arise from equi-probable two-way flips”; the p p -value is the exact two-sided binomial probability of observing max ⁡ ( b , c ) \max(b,c) or more extreme asymmetry given n = b + c n=b+c discordant pairs under b ∼ Binomial ⁡ ( n , 1 / 2 ) b\sim\mathrm{Binomial}(n,1/2) . Smaller p p provides stronger evidence against the null of “ A A and B B are equivalent”.
paragraphs.zh: 对于两种配置 A 和 B，令 b 为“A 命中且 B 未命中”的用户数，c 为“A 未命中且 B 命中”的用户数（即配对联列表中两个不一致的单元格）。 McNemar 检验的原假设为 H0: b = c，即“A 与 B 之间的 Hit@1 差异来源于等概率的双向翻转”；p 值是在 n = b + c 个不一致配对、且 b 服从 Binomial(n, 1/2) 的条件下，观察到 max(b, c) 或更极端不对称性的精确双侧二项概率。 p 值越小，提供的反对“A 与 B 等价”这一原假设的证据越强。

paragraphs.en: (i) Memory → \to Monologue ( b / c = 79 / 77 b/c=79/77 , p = 0.94 p=0.94 ): the two configurations are paired-indistinguishable; the result is both a statistical conclusion (cannot reject b = c b=c ) and a designed negative control: it rules out prompt-side profile injection as a source of gain. (ii) Monologue → \to Dialogue ( b / c = 51 / 108 b/c=51/108 , p = 7.2 × 10 − 6 p=7.2\times 10^{-6} ): moving the same profile from the reranker prompt to the retrieval-side homophily gate gains 108 108 users and loses 51 51 , and the net + 5.7 +5.7 pp is highly significant in the paired test. (iii) Dialogue → \to Consult ( b / c = 104 / 49 b/c=104/49 , p = 1.0 × 10 − 5 p=1.0\times 10^{-5} ): the reverse ablation, removing the retrieval-side gate, incurs a significant drop, confirming in the opposite direction that the retrieval-side gate, not a collateral artefact, is the operative component. (iv) Consult → \to Harp ( b / c = 43 / 106 b/c=43/106 , p = 2.5 × 10 − 7 p=2.5\times 10^{-7} ): re-enabling the retrieval-side gate together with Sync on top of Consult yields a significant paired asymmetry. (v) End-to-end Memory → \to Harp ( b / c = 62 / 125 b/c=62/125 , p = 4.8 × 10 − 6 p=4.8\times 10^{-6} ): Harp nets 125 − 62 = 63 125-62=63 additional hits over Memory ( + 6.3 +6.3 pp), matching the main-result gap. Taken together, every operative switch along the ablation ladder leaves a paired-significant imprint on Hit@1 , while the only non-significant row ( Memory → \to Monologue ) is precisely the negative control the design calls for.
paragraphs.zh: (i) Memory → \to Monologue ( b / c = 79 / 77 b/c=79/77 , p = 0.94 p=0.94 )：两种配置在配对检验下不可区分；该结果既是一个统计结论（无法拒绝 b = c b=c ），也是一个刻意设计的阴性对照：它排除了提示词侧画像注入作为增益来源的可能性。 (ii) Monologue → \to Dialogue ( b / c = 51 / 108 b/c=51/108 , p = 7.2 × 10 − 6 p=7.2\times 10^{-6} )：将同一画像从重排序器提示词移至检索侧同质性门控后，新增 108 108 个用户、损失 51 51 个，净提升 + 5.7 +5.7 个百分点在配对检验中高度显著。 (iii) Dialogue → \to Consult ( b / c = 104 / 49 b/c=104/49 , p = 1.0 × 10 − 5 p=1.0\times 10^{-5} )：反向消融，即移除检索侧门控，导致显著下降，从相反方向证实起作用的组件是检索侧门控本身，而非附带产物。 (iv) Consult → \to Harp ( b / c = 43 / 106 b/c=43/106 , p = 2.5 × 10 − 7 p=2.5\times 10^{-7} )：在 Consult 之上重新启用检索侧门控并加上 Sync，产生了显著的配对不对称。 (v) 端到端 Memory → \to Harp ( b / c = 62 / 125 b/c=62/125 , p = 4.8 × 10 − 6 p=4.8\times 10^{-6} )：相比 Memory，Harp 净增 125 − 62 = 63 125-62=63 个命中（ + 6.3 +6.3 个百分点），与主结果的差距相吻合。 综上所述，消融阶梯上每一个起作用的开关都在 Hit@1 上留下了配对显著的印记，而唯一不显著的行（ Memory → \to Monologue ）恰恰是该设计所需的阴性对照。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 spells out the four-phase pipeline described in § 3 step by step. The three boxed lines mark the three operators Harp adds on top of a standard memory-augmented agentic backbone: Build -item (Eq. 4 ), Understand via homophily-gated retrieval (Eq. 7 ), and Sync via a reflective update (Eq. 10 ). Understand operates on two edge types simultaneously: user–user edges ( u , n ) (u,n) (same-type agents, scored by symmetric preference -channel phrase overlap; floor α u ​ u \alpha_{uu} ) and user–item edges ( u , i n ) (u,i_{n}) (cross-type agents, scored by four-channel ℋ ⁡ ( ϕ u , ϕ i n ) \mathcal{H}(\phi_{u},\phi_{i_{n}}) ; floor α u ​ i \alpha_{ui} ). The two branches fire independently and on non-overlapping neighbour subsets within the same pruner call. Every other line is part of the standard backbone.

paragraphs.en: Table 7 lists the complete fixed hyperparameter setting. All values are set once at pipeline onboarding. Two parameters deserve explicit disambiguation: T wp T_{\mathrm{wp}} is the outer warmup round count for Build -user + reranker ( warmup.rounds in config); T evo T_{\mathrm{evo}} is the number of reflective calls per user in the Sync phase (conditioned on the second-to-last interaction). The main experiments in this paper use T evo = 1 T_{\mathrm{evo}}=1 via a cheap-evolve implementation that reuses the Phase 2 warmup case context and avoids an extra reranker call; the pipeline supports T evo > 1 T_{\mathrm{evo}}>1 with rotating history offsets in principle, which we do not use in the main experiments.

In all main experiments reported in this paper this module is disabled ( memory.enable_temporal_weighting: false ) to ensure strict comparability with the MemRec baseline; its empirical impact is left for future work.

paragraphs.en: We fix α u ​ i = 0.4 \alpha_{ui}=0.4 (user–item edges) and α u ​ u = 0.3 \alpha_{uu}=0.3 (user–user edges). Both floors have the same semantics: the least compatible collaborative neighbour retains roughly α \alpha of its baseline score, preventing the gate from discarding neighbours entirely while still providing meaningful routing. The two edge types take different floors reflecting a simple design trade-off: the user–item gate acts on a four-channel profile (richer signal, lower risk of misclassification), hence a higher floor to moderate gating strength; the user–user gate uses single-channel preference-phrase overlap (narrower signal), hence a lower floor for more aggressive re-weighting. The direction of the retrieval-vs-prompt effect reported in Table 3 is consistent with Remark 2 and with the floor sweep in Appendix F , so the primary empirical claim of Pillar 2 is not tied to the specific α \alpha values (Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们固定 α_{ui}=0.4（用户–物品边）和 α_{uu}=0.3（用户–用户边）。 两种下限具有相同的语义：最不兼容的协同邻居仍保留大约 α 的基线分数，从而防止门控完全丢弃邻居，同时仍能提供有意义的路由。 两类边采用不同的下限，反映了一个简单的设计权衡：用户–物品门控作用于四通道画像（信号更丰富、误分类风险更低），因此设置较高的下限以缓和门控强度；用户–用户门控使用单通道偏好短语重叠（信号较窄），因此设置较低的下限以进行更激进的重加权。 表 3 中报告的检索与提示效应的方向与注记 2 以及附录 F 中的下限扫描一致，因此支柱 2 的主要实证结论并不依赖于特定的 α 取值（附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: This appendix presents three worked examples from the 1,000 1{,}000 -user Yelp evaluation split, drawn directly from our per-user rank records. Each example contrasts Dialogue (channel-homophily variant, no Sync ) with full Harp ( Dialogue + prompt injection + Sync ). We deliberately pick one Sync-hurts case (User 157) and two Sync-helps cases (User 52 and User 366) to reflect the full picture of the + 0.8 +0.8 pp average Dialogue → \to Harp residual reported in Table 3 : the residual is a sum of individual-level wins and losses, not a uniform uplift.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录展示了来自 1,000 1{,}000 用户 Yelp 评测划分的三个完整示例，直接取自我们的逐用户排序记录。 每个示例都对比了 Dialogue（通道同质变体，无 Sync）与完整的 Harp（Dialogue + 提示注入 + Sync）。 我们刻意选取一个 Sync 有害的案例（User 157）和两个 Sync 有益的案例（User 52 和 User 366），以反映表 3 中报告的 + 0.8 +0.8 个百分点的 Dialogue → \to Harp 平均残差的全貌：该残差是个体层面得失的总和，而非一致的提升。

paragraphs.en: Applying the deterministic rule below to the 357 357 Harp misses on the 1,000 1{,}000 -user Yelp split yields Table 8 . The rule is first-match-wins in the ordering Sync ​ - ​ reg ≻ B1 ≻ B2 ≻ LLM ​ - ​ prior ≻ Other \mathrm{Sync\mbox{-}reg}\succ\mathrm{B1}\succ\mathrm{B2}\succ\mathrm{LLM\mbox{-}prior}\succ\mathrm{Other} : (Sync-reg) the ground truth sits inside the Dialogue top-3 but is not ranked first under Harp (a near-miss bucket that includes, but is not limited to, the Case 1 pattern of Appendix E.5 ); (B1) the instruction tokens have zero overlap with any user preference phrase (extractor under-covered intent); (B2) the top-1 and the ground-truth scores differ by ≤ 0.2 \leq 0.2 (reranker-bandwidth-limited); (LLM-prior) a gap of > 0.3 >0.3 without preference-overlap evidence (top-1 carried by a rating/recency prior orthogonal to ϕ u \phi_{u} ); (Other) residual. Relation to the methodology taxonomy. B1 and B2 follow the bottleneck definitions of § 3.5 loosely; the Sync-reg bucket, by contrast, is specific to this attribution exercise and collects near-miss cases; only its subset with a Dialogue top-1 hit is a true Hit@1 regression. It is therefore a separate audit category from the B3 Communicative Drift bottleneck of § 3.5 , which Sync is designed to address rather than to cause.
paragraphs.zh: 将以下确定性规则应用于 1,000 用户 Yelp 划分上的 357 个 Harp 未命中样本，得到表 8。 该规则按顺序 Sync-reg ≻ B1 ≻ B2 ≻ LLM-prior ≻ Other 采用首个命中即胜出：（Sync-reg）真值位于 Dialogue top-3 内但在 Harp 下未排名第一（一个近似命中的桶，包括但不限于附录 E.5 中案例 1 的模式）；（B1）指令词元与任何用户偏好短语零重叠（抽取器覆盖不足的意图）；（B2）top-1 与真值分数之差 ≤ 0.2（受重排序带宽限制）；（LLM-prior）在无偏好重叠证据的情况下差距 > 0.3（top-1 由与 ϕ_u 正交的评分/新近性先验承载）；（Other）残余。 与方法论分类法的关系。 B1 和 B2 粗略地遵循 § 3.5 的瓶颈定义；相比之下，Sync-reg 桶专用于本次归因分析，收集近似命中的案例；只有其中 Dialogue top-1 命中的子集才是真正的 Hit@1 回退。 因此，它是与 § 3.5 的 B3 交际漂移瓶颈不同的独立审计类别；Sync 旨在解决而非引发该瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: For completeness and reproducibility, this appendix reproduces the natural-language prompts that instantiate each operator of Harp . The templates correspond exactly to the prompt-builder functions in src/memory/com_manager.py with the templates under prompts/ (retrieval, feedback update, profile extraction), src/models/reranker_llm.py (reranker), and src/profiles/user_profile.py (profile generation and reflection). All prompts are issued to gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 with a JSON-mode structured output constraint, at temperature = 0 =0 except for profile generation and reflection ( 0.3 0.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为保证完整性与可复现性，本附录复现了 Harp 中用于实例化每个算子的自然语言提示词。 这些模板与 src/memory/com_manager.py 中的提示词构建函数（检索、反馈更新、画像抽取）以及 prompts/ 下的模板、src/models/reranker_llm.py（重排序）和 src/profiles/user_profile.py（画像生成与反思）中的函数一一对应。 所有提示词均发送至 gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18，并采用 JSON 模式的结构化输出约束，除画像生成与反思（ 0.3 0.3 ）外，温度均为 temperature = 0 =0。

paragraphs.en: This operator is the entry point of the communication policy: given the user’s personal memory bullets and the serialised neighbour table, the LLM extracts N f = 7 N_{f}=7 preference facets together with their confidences and supporting neighbour lists, and assigns edge weights w ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] w\in[0,1] on the collaborative subgraph. Its output is consumed by the channel-homophily retriever of Eq. 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 该算子是通信策略的入口点：给定用户的个人记忆要点和序列化的邻居表，LLM 提取 N_f = 7 个偏好方面及其置信度和支持邻居列表，并在协作子图上分配 w ∈ [0, 1] 的边权重。 其输出被公式 7 的通道同质性检索器所使用。

paragraphs.en: The reranker of § 3.1 receives the retrieval-operator facets, the current user instruction, and the | C | |C| candidate items together with their memory summaries. It emits a list-wise ranking over all | C | |C| candidates in a single call. An optional instruction-priority switch (not used in our experiments) additionally marks the instruction as the primary criterion and the facets as secondary signals.
paragraphs.zh: § 3.1 的重排序器接收检索算子方面、当前用户指令，以及 | C | |C| 个候选条目及其记忆摘要。 它在单次调用中对所有 | C | |C| 个候选项输出一个列表式排序。 一个可选的指令优先开关（在我们的实验中未使用）会额外将指令标记为主要标准，并将各方面标记为次要信号。

paragraphs.en: This appendix gives the per-phase computational cost of Algorithm 1 , consistent with the design principles of § 3 ; all counts refer to wall-time-relevant LLM calls.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录给出了算法 1 各阶段的计算成本，与 §3 的设计原则保持一致；所有计数均指与实际运行时间相关的 LLM 调用。

paragraphs.en: Phase 1 ( Build -item): zero LLM calls; O ⁡ ( | ℐ | ) O(|\mathcal{I}|) rule-extraction operations, amortised once across the full item set (not per-user). Phase 2 ( Build -user + + warmup): T wp = 1 T_{\mathrm{wp}}{=}1 warmup pass (as in Phase 4), plus O ⁡ ( k ​ | 𝒞 | ) O(k|\mathcal{C}|) phrase-matching for channel homophily (non-LLM). Phase 3 ( Sync ): T evo = 1 T_{\mathrm{evo}}{=}1 reflective call, which also builds the profile (the main experiments use the cheap-evolve implementation, which reuses the Phase 2 warmup case context and fires a single reflection conditioned on the second-to-last interaction); the critic is computed deterministically from the Sync-operator output and adds no separate LLM call; the pipeline supports the T evo > 1 T_{\mathrm{evo}}>1 multi-offset variant but we do not use it in the main experiments. Phase 4 (Eval): the same per-query LLM calls as MemRec (Stage-R, reranking, and a memory write when feedback is observed) + + O ⁡ ( k ​ | 𝒞 | ) O(k|\mathcal{C}|) homophily re-weighting.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段1（Build-item）：零次 LLM 调用；O(|\mathcal{I}|) 次规则抽取操作，在整个物品集合上摊销一次（而非按用户摊销）。 阶段2（Build-user++ warmup）：T_{\mathrm{wp}}{=}1 次预热遍历（如阶段4所示），外加 O(k|\mathcal{C}|) 次用于频道同质性的短语匹配（非 LLM）。 阶段3（Sync）：T_{\mathrm{evo}}{=}1 次反思调用，该调用同时构建画像（主实验使用 cheap-evolve 实现，该实现复用阶段2的预热案例上下文，并基于倒数第二次交互触发一次反思）；评论者（critic）由 Sync 算子的输出确定性地计算得出，不增加单独的 LLM 调用；该流水线支持 T_{\mathrm{evo}}>1 的多偏移变体，但我们在主实验中未使用它。 阶段4（Eval）：与 MemRec 相同的每查询 LLM 调用（Stage-R、重排序，以及在观察到反馈时进行一次记忆写入）+ O(k|\mathcal{C}|) 次同质性重新加权。

paragraphs.en: To enable post-hoc attribution for every recommendation (success or miss), Harp persists a structured record for each eval case in results/{run_tag}/eval_traces.json . Each case entry records the user, the ground truth and its rank, the candidate list, the final ranking with per-item scores, the instruction, the Stage-R facets, and Hit@ k k indicators. Together with the item profiles, these records are the input to the per-miss attribution analysis (Appendix E.5 ), whose first-match-wins classification (Sync-reg / B1 / B2 / LLM-prior / Other) is reported in Table 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了能够对每条推荐结果（无论成功还是未命中）进行事后归因，Harp 会在 results/{run_tag}/eval_traces.json 中为每个评估用例持久化一条结构化记录。 每条用例记录包含用户、真实值及其排名、候选列表、带有逐项得分的最终排序、指令、Stage-R 的各个侧面（facet），以及 Hit@k 指标。 这些记录与物品画像一起，构成了逐次未命中归因分析（附录 E.5）的输入，其采用“首次匹配即命中”的分类方式（Sync-reg / B1 / B2 / LLM-prior / Other），结果报告于表 8。

paragraphs.en: The operational fact underlying the retrieval-vs-prompt design rationale of § 3.3 is that an LLM reranker operates under a finite context budget B B : when
paragraphs.zh: 支撑 §3.3 中检索与提示（retrieval-vs-prompt）设计原理的运作事实是：大语言模型（LLM）重排器在有限的上下文预算 B B 下运行：当

paragraphs.en: information may be truncated at the model’s context edge, and the truncation strategy is out of our control. In our deployment the reranker prompt is built from four blocks: the instruction template P template P_{\mathrm{template}} , the candidate block with metadata and memory summaries for each of the | C | = 10 |C|{=}10 candidates, the collaborative-memory block M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} , and (when enabled by ablation flag) the user profile ϕ u \phi_{u} . Adding a per-candidate item profile ϕ i \phi_{i} linearly inflates the candidate block; under Eq. 12 , once B B is saturated the marginal token cost is charged against M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}} (Remark 2 ). A retrieval-side injection, by contrast, consumes tokens only during the candidate-admission step, whose budget is independent of B B ; this is the operational reason behind the “unbounded retrieval-side headroom” anticipated by § 3.3 , and the algorithmic instantiation of bottleneck B2 (channel capture) of § 3.5 ; corresponding empirical evidence is reported in Table 3 of § 4 and in the per-miss attribution of Table 8 (Appendix E.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 信息可能在模型上下文边界处被截断，且截断策略不在我们的控制范围内。 在我们的部署中，重排器的提示由四个部分构成：指令模板 P template P_{\mathrm{template}}、包含 10 个（| C | = 10 |C|{=}10）候选各自元数据与记忆摘要的候选块、协同记忆块 M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}}，以及在消融开关启用时的用户画像 ϕ u \phi_{u}。 为每个候选项添加条目画像 ϕ i \phi_{i} 会使候选块线性膨胀；根据式 12，一旦 B B 饱和，边际 token 成本将转嫁给 M collab M_{\mathrm{collab}}（见注 2）。 相比之下，检索侧注入仅在候选准入步骤消耗 token，其预算与 B B 无关；这是 § 3.3 所预期的“无界检索侧余量”背后的运行层面原因，也是 § 3.5 中瓶颈 B2（信道捕获）的算法化实例；相应的实证证据见 § 4 的表 3 以及表 8（附录 E.5）中的逐未命中归因。

On top of the metadata-parsed fields, reviews i \mathrm{reviews}_{i} (when provided) is scanned against 𝒟 \mathcal{D} with longest-match to locate controlled phrases, merged into the channel declared in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} as fine-grained evidence; structured descriptions are handled by R1.

paragraphs.en: Quality-signal induction. The quality channel is filled by a monotone rule over review statistics ( r ¯ i , n i ) (\bar{r}_{i},n_{i}) discretised into three bins { high-quality signal , average , inconsistent } \{\textit{high-quality signal},\textit{average},\textit{inconsistent}\} to suppress noise from extremely sparse reviews.

paragraphs.en: Channel-exclusivity projection. A fixed priority preference ≻ quality ≻ context ≻ audience \texttt{preference}\succ\texttt{quality}\succ\texttt{context}\succ\texttt{audience} is imposed on phrases routed to multiple channels by R1–R3, ensuring { ϕ i ( c ) } c ∈ 𝒞 \{\phi_{i}^{(c)}\}_{c\in\mathcal{C}} are pairwise disjoint so that the channel-wise aggregation of Eq. 6 does not double-count.
paragraphs.zh: 信道排他性投影。 对于由 R1–R3 路由到多个信道的短语，施加固定的优先级 preference ≻ quality ≻ context ≻ audience \texttt{preference}\succ\texttt{quality}\succ\texttt{context}\succ\texttt{audience}，确保 { ϕ i ( c ) } c ∈ 𝒞 \{\phi_{i}^{(c)}\}_{c\in\mathcal{C}} 两两不相交，从而使式 6 的逐信道聚合不会重复计算。

paragraphs.en: Design rationale. The extractor is built on three principles: (i) scalability : item-side profiling is linear in N I N_{I} and LLM-free, feasible at N I ∼ 10 4 N_{I}\sim 10^{4} – 10 5 10^{5} ; (ii) auditability : every step from metadata/reviews to profile phrases is replayable and traceable to a dictionary entry; (iii) channel alignment : the output schema is strictly isomorphic to the user-side profile, giving the per-channel homophily of Eq. 6 a well-defined basis of comparison. Given ( meta i , reviews i ) (\mathrm{meta}_{i},\mathrm{reviews}_{i}) , Π \Pi is fully determined by ( 𝒮 , 𝒟 ) (\mathcal{S},\mathcal{D}) , which are authored from the domain ontology and controlled vocabulary without any downstream-metric tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 设计依据。 该提取器建立在三条原则之上：(i) 可扩展性：物品侧画像的复杂度与 N_I 呈线性关系，且不依赖大语言模型，在 N_I 约为 10^4–10^5 规模时可行；(ii) 可审计性：从元数据/评论到画像短语的每一步都可重放，并可追溯到词典条目；(iii) 通道对齐：输出模式与用户侧画像严格同构，为公式 6 的逐通道同质性提供了明确的比较基础。 给定 (meta_i, reviews_i)，Π 完全由 (𝒮, 𝒟) 决定，二者依据领域本体和受控词表编写，无需任何针对下游指标的调优。

paragraphs.en: The asymmetric soft Jaccard of Eq. 5 applies directly to the phrase-set channels preference and audience . For the quality and context channels, whose fields are not phrase sets, sem \mathrm{sem} uses channel-specific fallbacks: the quality channel maps the user’s free-text quality_bar (e.g. a star threshold) onto the item labels from R3; sem \mathrm{sem} is implemented as “item quality ≥ \geq user-preferred threshold ⇒ 1 \Rightarrow 1 , otherwise linear interpolation into [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ”. The context channel uses short location and setting phrases (the user side falls back to city_preference ); sem \mathrm{sem} is a bidirectional substring hit: 1 1 on hit, 0 0 on miss, neutral 0.5 0.5 when either side is empty. All three forms participate uniformly in Eq. 6 under the sem ⁡ ( ϕ u ( c ) , ϕ i ( c ) ) \mathrm{sem}(\phi_{u}^{(c)},\phi_{i}^{(c)}) notation.
paragraphs.zh: 式 5 中的非对称软 Jaccard 可直接应用于短语集通道 preference 和 audience。 对于字段不是短语集的 quality 和 context 通道，sem \mathrm{sem} 采用通道特定的回退方式：quality 通道将用户的自由文本 quality_bar（例如星级阈值）映射到 R3 中的条目标签上；sem \mathrm{sem} 实现为「条目质量 ≥ \geq 用户偏好阈值 ⇒ 1 \Rightarrow 1，否则线性插值到 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1]」。 context 通道使用简短的地点和场景短语（用户侧回退到 city_preference）；sem \mathrm{sem} 是双向子串命中：命中时为 1 1，未命中时为 0 0，任一侧为空时为中性值 0.5 0.5。 这三种形式都在 sem ⁡ ( ϕ u ( c ) , ϕ i ( c ) ) \mathrm{sem}(\phi_{u}^{(c)},\phi_{i}^{(c)}) 记法下统一参与式 6 的计算。

paragraphs.en: Each of the four benchmarks has its own schema map 𝒮 dataset \mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{dataset}} and phrase dictionary 𝒟 dataset \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{dataset}} , authored once at onboarding from the item-side metadata vocabulary of that benchmark. Coverage (the fraction of items for which a given channel of ϕ i \phi_{i} is non-empty after R1–R4) is high on the three structured domains (Yelp, MovieTV, Books) where item metadata carries controlled categorical tags, and noticeably lower on Goodreads (especially on the context and audience channels) because item metadata there is dominated by free-text summaries rather than categorical tags. This is the same structural reason the Dialogue Gain on Goodreads is the weakest of the four benchmarks (§ 4 , Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 四个基准各自拥有自己的模式映射 𝒮 dataset \mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{dataset}} 和短语词典 𝒟 dataset \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{dataset}}，它们在接入时依据该基准的条目侧元数据词表一次性编写完成。 覆盖率（在 R1–R4 之后，ϕ i \phi_{i} 的给定通道非空的条目所占比例）在三个结构化领域（Yelp、MovieTV、Books）上很高，因为这些领域的条目元数据带有受控的分类标签；而在 Goodreads 上则明显较低（尤其是上下文通道和受众通道），因为那里的条目元数据以自由文本摘要为主，而非分类标签。 这正是 Goodreads 上的 Dialogue Gain（对话增益）在四个基准中最弱的同一个结构性原因（§ 4，图 3）。

paragraphs.en: Under identical code and candidate pools, Harp outperforms MemRec on every dataset with three further backbones (Table 9 ), including the open-weight qwen3-30b.
paragraphs.zh: 在相同的代码和候选池下，Harp 在另外三个骨干模型（表 9）上的每个数据集上都优于 MemRec，其中包括开放权重的 qwen3-30b。

paragraphs.en: All methods rank the same fixed candidate pool (the ground truth plus 9 sampled negatives), so gains come from ranking the ground truth higher within the pool. With only the consumption locus changed, retrieval-side gating improves Hit@1 over Memory by + 5.5 +5.5 / + 2.9 +2.9 pp on Yelp / MovieTV, more than reranker-side injection (Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法对同一个固定的候选池（真值加上 9 个采样的负例）进行排序，因此提升来自在池中将真值排得更靠前。 在仅改变消费位置的情况下，检索侧门控在 Yelp / MovieTV 上的 Hit@1 相比 Memory 分别提升 + 5.5 +5.5 / + 2.9 +2.9 个百分点，超过重排序侧注入（表 3）。

paragraphs.en: With uniform channel weights the gain over Memory remains positive on all four datasets but is smallest; the default and a preference-heavy setting differ by at most 0.5 0.5 pp. Stronger or weaker homophily floors also keep a positive gain, and the default floors lie near the top of this band. Across candidate-pool sizes | C | ∈ { 5 , 10 , 20 } |C|\in\{5,10,20\} , Harp stays above both Memory and Dialogue on Yelp.
paragraphs.zh: 在使用统一信道权重时，相对 Memory 的增益在全部四个数据集上均保持为正，但幅度最小；默认设置与偏好权重较高的设置之间的差异至多 0.5 个百分点。 更强或更弱的同质性下限也保持了正增益，且默认下限位于该区间的顶部附近。 在候选池大小 |C|∈{5,10,20} 的范围内，Harp 在 Yelp 上始终高于 Memory 和 Dialogue 两种方法。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation follows the accuracy-oriented InstructRec protocol. The floor α \alpha of the homophily gate offers a simple way to soften the gate where exploration matters, for example for users with short histories, and beyond-accuracy measures such as novelty and diversity are a natural extension of this evaluation. Profiles are built only from observed interactions, but may inherit biases of the LLM backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估遵循以准确性为导向的 InstructRec 协议。 同质性门的下限 α \alpha 提供了一种简单的方法，可以在探索重要的场景下软化该门控，例如对历史记录较短的用户；而新颖性和多样性等超越准确性的指标则是该评估的自然延伸。 用户画像仅根据观察到的交互构建，但可能继承大语言模型骨干的偏见。

sents.en: Our evaluation follows the accuracy-oriented InstructRec protocol.
sents.zh: 我们的评估遵循以准确性为导向的 InstructRec 协议。

paragraphs.en: On 1,000 Yelp queries with gpt-4o-mini, ranking a query takes two LLM calls (Stage-R and rerank), with a memory write when feedback is observed, as in MemRec; mean end-to-end latency is 10.81 10.81 s ( p 95 = 13.28 p_{95}=13.28 s), and pruning with the homophily gate takes about 0.6 0.6 ms. Item profiles are rule-extracted offline and user profiles are built once per user.
paragraphs.zh: 在 1,000 条 Yelp 查询上使用 gpt-4o-mini，对一条查询进行排序需要两次大语言模型调用（Stage-R 和重排序），并在观察到反馈时进行一次记忆写入，与 MemRec 相同；平均端到端延迟为 10.81 10.81 秒（ p 95 = 13.28 p_{95}=13.28 秒），而使用同质性门控进行剪枝大约需要 0.6 0.6 毫秒。 物品档案通过规则离线抽取得到，用户档案则每个用户只构建一次。
